rule_before_measurement: Same accepted FP16/FP32 XMX baseline, original vector INT8 split control and SwiGLU/down-quant fusion. Normal process priority, free OS thread scheduling, actual profiling-enabled default queue, no diagnostic markers/profiling reads. Fixed split/fused/fused/split full cohorts, no rerun selection. All 48 format/T/layout cells per cohort; GU22/16/42, down42,N2560,F640,eight raw banks. 64warm,8ABBA cycles,128chains/arm,batch8;stable iff both endpoint drifts<=3%, >=6/8stable and stable median throughput gain>=3%, existing normal/outlier accuracy gates. Preserve saturated FP16 SwiGLU rounding, exact hidden and final INT8 output parity, edge-check padding/zero/saturation/nonfinite/guards. Retain only original 21 cells passing both fused cohorts; report all controls and failures. Fusion retains hidden store for parity; removes separate SwiGLU submission and next global hidden read. No persistent repack cache,PCIe/model timing or model quality claim; not adopted.
